newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-STEWART STEPS DOWN AS SURREY CAPTAIN.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-STEWART STEPS DOWN AS SURREY CAPTAIN.

text.p: Alec Stewart has resigned as Surrey captain after five years in charge in order to concentrate on his wicketkeeping duties.
Stewart enjoyed a highly successful tour with England to Zimbabwe and New Zealand as number three batsman and wicketkeeper.
He has previously kept wicket for Surrey in one-day games only but now plans to wear the gloves in most of Surrey's matches.
Adam Hollioake, who led England A on their productive visit to Australia, will take over from Stewart. Hollioake, 25, has been mentioned as a possible England skipper.
Gloucestershire have signed 26-year-old Tasmanian all-rounder Shaun Young as their overseas player on a one-year contract.
